subject: Full-screen job census (host replay) + model: fetch breaks are 50-97% of FS jobs; tile-fetch batching + 128-draw cap -> 1 FS job/frame
body: Tool: gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/fsjobs/fsjobs.py (frame_bench prelude + fake-kernel hook: per JM job FB size, draws, preload, scissor-union tile coverage; experiments patch a SHADOW copy of gpu/metal, production untouched) and model_table.py. Census of the first steady batched frame, today (tree): full-screen jobs tick 4, small 12, medium 24, large 40, ca200 11, blur_heavy 2; why: every luma_boost fetch draw is its own FS job (break rdtgt 3/11/24/40/10/2) and the F-runs between them are the rest; medium/large passes on the display already merge across encoders (same target, LOAD); other jobs = offscreen CLEAR passes, one per target (0/0/3/6/10/12, inherent: separate framebuffers). No clear/preclear/mrt/shape/spans/fit breaks in these shapes. Experiment A (-DTEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT + 2-line compositor hunk): FS jobs 1/1/2/3/5/1, remaining break = maxdraw 32 (the luma variant compiles to LD_TILE: reads_fb=2, flags TILE_FETCH). Experiment B (A + N2MB_BATCH_MAX 128): FS 1/1/1/1/2/1 (draws per job 5/18/36/80/128+32/10). Coverage of FS jobs by draw scissors (upper bound of INTERSECT tiles): 2.7/8.8/8.8/19.6/59+16/5.1%. Model (c6jb fit; pipelined max(GPU, encode), encode = frame_bench +tree measured), ms/frame before -> A+B -> A+B+INTERSECT: tree levers: tick 23.0->5.8->4.6, small 69.0->5.8->4.7, medium 148.2->15.9->14.8, large 250.4->26.1->25.1, ca200 97.1->45.4->43.9, blur 52.1->46.4->45.3; with P3 poll+654 MHz+async: 7.0->1.8->1.1, 20.9->1.8->1.2, 43.2->3.2->2.6, 72.5->4.6->4.1, 23.9->8.2->7.5, 9.2->7.5->6.9. CAVEAT: the model prices a job by class (5.75 ms FS) independent of its draw count, so merging 36-80 draws into one job is optimistic: per-draw shading is not modelled; synthetic scissor boxes (150x150) not real CA geometry. Needed for A: compositor hunk (encode) + TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT in the device build (root). B: my bridge hunks once encode-cpu posts DONE on nord2_metal_bridge.c, then encode's frontend 2-liner (capacity).
